tests.assertion: test('4895/2448未烧伤不删，有烧伤删除强音清敌回合并臣服，删除弱音清强并使用结束理论吸取；删除不是消耗不授免疫',()=>{const none=prepareNotes(make({move:38355,index:0,hp:1000}),[3,1]);turn(none,38355,null);assert.deepEqual(values(none),[3,1]);const s=prepareNotes(make({move:38355,index:0,hp:1000}),[3,1]);s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;let afterHitHP,afterUseHP;const engine=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...engine,run(p,o,c){const out=engine.run(p,o,c);if(c.a.side===0&&p==='afterHit')afterHitHP=c.a.hp;if(c.a.side===0&&p==='afterUse')afterUseHP=c.a.hp;return out;}};try{turn(s,38355,null);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=engine;}assert.deepEqual(values(s),[]);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['臣服']);assert.equal(afterHitHP,1000);assert.equal(afterUseHP,4000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify??0,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,0);assert.equal(score(s).executionImmunity?.length??0,0);});

tests.assertion: test('4895全部17招有序编译、64种子基础与真实2082原生逐招释放，已知首次无音符或单次资源不跨未确认边界，三个未知明确拒绝存储',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.basePPCostThisUse.amount,1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4895 base '+m.id);}assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2082].sourceHash,'f9cab88');assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2082].partial,true);assert.equal(require('../local-species.cjs').save(source).saved,false);});

tests.name: 4895/2449错误顺序也逐音符消费但不获得天在此，三个强中弱当前免伤免异免秒分别真实触发，秒杀免疫不误挡普通真实伤害
tests.assertion: test('4895/2449错误顺序也逐音符消费但不获得天在此，三个强中弱当前免伤免异免秒分别真实触发，秒杀免疫不误挡普通真实伤害',()=>{const s=prepareNotes(make({move:29328,index:0,loadout:[38359,29327,38354,38355,29328]}),[3,2,1]);turn(s,29328,null);assert.equal(score(s).heaven,0);assert.deepEqual(values(s),[]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(score(s).executionImmunity.length,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'麻痹',c.t,false,false,2);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,100,'普通真实伤害','true');assert.equal(score({fighters:[c.t]}).executionImmunity.length,1);c.defeat(c.t,'测试真实秒杀',{instantKill:true});assert.ok(c.t.hp>0);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.score4895.executionImmunity.length,0);}},()=>turn(s,38359,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,0);});

tests.name: 4895/2449同谱第一次天在此、第二次天曾在此、第三次天依常在此并仅该次秒杀，已有免秒可阻击败而状态升级保留
tests.assertion: test('4895/2449同谱第一次天在此、第二次天曾在此、第三次天依常在此并仅该次秒杀，已有免秒可阻击败而状态升级保留',()=>{const s=make({move:29328,index:0,loadout:[38359,29327,38354,38355,29328]});for(let n=1;n<=3;n++){prepareNotes(s,[3,1,2,1]);if(n===3)s.fighters[1].soulState.score4895={notes:[],serial:0,heaven:0,heavenGains:0,events:[],weakDrains:[],ppRestoredTotal:0,executionImmunity:[{serial:1}]};turn(s,29328,null);assert.equal(score(s).heaven,n);assert.equal(score(s).heavenGains,n);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);}prepareNotes(s,[3,1,2,1]);s.fighters[0].pp[key(29328)]=3;turn(s,29328,null);assert.equal(score(s).heaven,3);assert.equal(score(s).heavenGains,4);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);const kill=make({move:29328,index:0});prepareNotes(kill,[3,1,2,1]);score(kill).heavenGains=2;score(kill).heaven=2;turn(kill,29328,null);assert.equal(kill.fighters[1].hp,0);});

tests.name: 4895/2450获得、2448删除、2449消耗均须技能生效，整招无效不修改原音符；控制未用也不消费，零伤命中仍能施洗获得中音
tests.assertion: test('4895/2450获得、2448删除、2449消耗均须技能生效，整招无效不修改原音符；控制未用也不消费，零伤命中仍能施洗获得中音',()=>{for(const [move,index,notes]of[[29327,0,[]],[38355,0,[3,1]],[29328,0,[3,1,2,1]]]){const s=prepareNotes(make({move,index}),notes);s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,move,20117);assert.deepEqual(score(s).notes.map(n=>n.value),notes);}const blocked=prepareNotes(make({move:29328,index:0}),[3,1,2,1]);blocked.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']=2;turn(blocked,29328,20117);assert.deepEqual(score(blocked).notes.map(n=>n.value),[3,1,2,1]);const zero=make({move:38354,index:1});timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero);assert.deepEqual(score(zero).notes.map(n=>n.value),[2]);});

tests.name: 4895源范围最终分类：魂印自动生音没有多精灵延期，2449仅真实下场保留及904下只盾封明确分离，当前个人音符不靠延期豁免
tests.assertion: test('4895源范围最终分类：魂印自动生音没有多精灵延期，2449仅真实下场保留及904下只盾封明确分离，当前个人音符不靠延期豁免',()=>{assert.deepEqual(E.SOULS.registry[2082].deferred,[]);assert.ok(E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[2449].deferred.includes('下场保留'));const m=H.source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38366),text=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[904].deferredFor(m.effectInstances[0].args,m,0);assert.ok(text.includes('下只真实出场'));assert.ok(text.includes('当前自耗'));assert.ok(!text.includes('整条等待'));});

tests.assertion: test('4895/1861整招无效才清敌回合并沉默3，控制未用不执行补偿，零伤命中不执行补偿且原音符不被无效技能消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['invalid','control','valid']){const s=prepareNotes(make({move:29328,index:1}),[3,1]);if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']=2;turn(s,29328,20117);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['沉默'],mode==='invalid');if(mode==='invalid')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['沉默'],3);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.score4895.notes.map(x=>x.value),[3,1]);}});
